criteria.text: Given the Command Center, when it is opened, then every tab is reachable and every card drills down one level.
Given sample mode, when any tab is shown, then the sample data is visibly labelled as sample.
Given the data files, when any tab renders, then its content comes from .colaberry/plan.json and .colaberry/progress.json read at runtime rather than from hard-coded values.
Given .colaberry/manifest.json, when any tab is shown, then it displays how old the data is and warns when that age exceeds a week.
Trust — no tab shows a number, a connection or a result the project has not actually produced.
Given a production change request, when the request is submitted, then it must require human approval.
Given a denied approval, When the request is resubmitted, Then it must still require approval.
Trust: Every approval decision is logged for audit.
Given an action is taken, when it is logged, then it must be retrievable in the audit log.
Given a decision is made, when it is logged, then it must include the decision maker.
Trust: Every log entry is timestamped and immutable.

note_totals: stories_total/stories_verified count the 11 real programme stories (plan.stories); criteria_total/criteria_passed reflect STORY-000, STORY-001 and STORY-002's criteria, since those are the only three stories with acceptance criteria defined so far — this will expand as later stories get built. 'submitted' means the criteria are backed by passing tests but no reviewer/commit sign-off has moved the story to 'verified' yet.

r2McpServer.description: MCP server built on the official @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, run over stdio (index.ts) and a thin HTTP wrapper (httpServer.ts) for local verification. One read-only resource + tool: read_sql_server_dmv, backed by dmvReader.ts/dmvLiveSource.ts, parameterized and honestly fixture-fallback when no live SQL Server is connected.

r4Guardrail.description: checkRemediationGuardrail() rejects any remediation missing evidence, an allowed action type, or an approved (not denied, not absent) human decision.

auditLog.description: AuditLog (guardrails/auditLog.ts) records two entry kinds — decisions (STORY-001: approve/deny, actor = decision maker) and actions (STORY-002: guardrail-evaluated remediation attempts, executed/blocked + violations, actor = whoever/whatever triggered it). Every entry has a required id (the idempotency key), is retrievable via retrieve(id) with an explicit found/not-found result, is frozen on write, and rejects entries missing required fields. Does not cover the full detection -> recommendation -> approval -> execution-outcome trail from R4 property 4 — no detection/recommendation subsystem exists yet (R1 is UNMAPPED).
